status_summary: On 2025-01-20 the Acting Secretary terminated all current memberships on DHS advisory committees effective immediately, with former members allowed to reapply; the memo names no committee, and the Homeland Security Advisory Council is a DHS advisory committee within its stated scope. DHS renewed the Council's charter effective 2025-03-05 (90 FR 11749, published 2025-03-11), cutting maximum membership from 40 to 35, setting three-year terms and replacing co-chairs with a Chair and Vice Chair. A notice published 2025-06-16 announced a Council meeting at which a new Chair and Vice Chair would be introduced and members sworn in, moved to 2025-07-02 by a notice of 2025-06-26, and a meeting on 2025-12-10 was noticed on 2025-12-03 to discuss new taskings.

timeline.event: Acting Secretary Benjamine Huffman issued a memorandum terminating all current memberships on DHS advisory committees effective immediately; former members could reapply.

DHS published notice that the Secretary renewed the Council's charter effective 2025-03-05, reducing maximum membership from 40 to 35, setting three-year terms and replacing co-chairs with a Chair and Vice Chair.
DHS published notice of a Council meeting (first set for 2025-06-30, later moved to 2025-07-02) at which a new Chair and Vice Chair would be introduced and members sworn in.

title: Remove all members of the Homeland Security Advisory Council and replace them
uncertainties: The January memo does not name the Homeland Security Advisory Council; its coverage of the Council rests on the memo's wording that it applies to all DHS advisory committees, and the Council is chartered as one. The March 2025 termination notice (eight committees) does not list the Council, consistent with the Council being kept and reconstituted rather than terminated. The meeting notices do not list members or name the new Chair and Vice Chair, a notice published 2025-06-26 (90 FR 27330) moved the meeting from 2025-06-30 to 2025-07-02 without restating the agenda, and it was not verified that the meeting occurred as noticed. The Mandate text uses the word Committee; the body is called Council. The memo copy was read through a third-party host, not dhs.gov, and a search of dhs.gov on 2026-10-22 found no official copy. A DHS release of 2025-06-24 announcing appointments to the Council could not be fetched from dhs.gov on 2026-10-18, so no roster was read. Searched 2026-10-26 for Council terminations, resignations or charter changes after 2025-12-10 and found nothing; a Federal Register query for 2026 notices returned no Council notice.
